parts.description: On a component's icon (`svg`): its Solar name, such as `close-linear`. The stroke width follows `--ok-icon-stroke`.
parts.name: data-ok-icon

parts.description: js` script: the folder of its lazy modules, when it isn't `modules/` next to the script.
parts.name: data-ok-modules

parts.description: js` script: lazy modules to load at once, separated by spaces, such as `chart data-grid`.
parts.name: data-ok-preload

parts.description: `off` keeps the HTML runtime away from this element and everything inside it. React writes it on interactive roots.
parts.name: data-ok-runtime

parts.description: Applies a color scheme to this element and everything inside it.
parts.name: data-ok-theme
